versions.name: Cub and Webelos Adventure Camp

features.note: Central dining hall seating four hundred, with a fireplace.
Campfire amphitheatre with a stage, lighting, and sound.
A western fort bunkhouse of ten rooms, and a castle pool building.
Private showers at the pool complex and showers at the western fort.
Two covered outdoor program areas at the nature lodge.
A nature lodge with a nature trail directly outside.
A castle-themed pool and spray-ground complex.
A pond with a fishing dock built to resemble a wooden ship.

versions.summary: Cub Scout resident camp operated by the Heart of Virginia Council at the Heart of Virginia Scout Reservation in Maidens, Virginia.

provenance.notes: Imported from camp-finder; raw description and sessions dropped (operational data stays at the council site). verified_at is camp-finder's own source-confirmation date; imported_at is when open-scout-api ingested it. The evergreen summary is original prose regenerated from that description, excluding dates/fees/schedules. camp_type classified from program_types. Features surveyed 2026-07-25 against the council's own camp page (that page is explicitly not an exhaustive activity list, so absence of a code is not evidence of absence).
